description: A Java class 'BrowseFragment' that extends Fragment, used for browsing media items via MediaBrowser, displaying them in a ListView, and handling media item selection.

classes.name: BrowseFragment
classes.description: A Fragment for browsing media items using MediaBrowser, displaying in a ListView, and handling item selection.

classes.name: BrowseAdapter
classes.description: An ArrayAdapter subclass for displaying MediaBrowser.MediaItem objects in a list.

classes.name: ViewHolder
classes.description: A static inner class within BrowseAdapter for holding views for list item layout.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of BrowseFragment with specified mediaId.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes the media browser, and sets up the list view.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects the MediaBrowser when fragment starts.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Disconnects the MediaBrowser when fragment stops.
